ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the diagonals AC and BD of the rhombus ABCD intersect at point O, and E is the midpoint of AB. Connect OE. If the perimeter of the rhombus ABCD is 32, what is the length of OE?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that the perimeter of rhombus ABCD is 32,\\
it follows that BA=8, and AC$\perp$BD,\\
which implies $\angle$AOB=90$^\circ$,\\
since point E is the midpoint of AB,\\
it follows that OE=$ \frac{1}{2}$AB=$\boxed{4}$.
